summary: Segmentation of every source step of both legs ran for all 22 participants (3,147 recordings, 107,367 steps) as a derived layer on the merged-pass tables; stance force mask built and applied as a separate layer (pass not rerun). Separate readback passed.
readback_code: contributor_tools/run_gt21_rb_segment_readback.py (separate file; independent scalar code for steps and mask)
force_mask_rule: stance true and the foot's owned-plate vertical force below 20 N -> grf vertical/anterior/lateral missing. 20 N fixed before results: 1.5x the ~13 N levelground Treadmill-plate offset, same as GT23 rule, absolute not BW fraction. Stored as layer force_mask/<ID>/<mode>/<rec>.parquet (time_s, force_missing_left/right); apply_force_mask() sets NaN.
events_of_the_run: Pilot r1 passed; AB06 batch r1 aborted at the treadmill recordings (address-space cap, 'cannot allocate memory for thread-local data'; receipt gt21-rb03-batch-AB06-launcher-receipt.json kept); fixed by one Arrow thread and eager garbage collection; pilot r2 passed with the same bound code as all 22 batches; AB06 r1 partial output deleted by this worker (its own, incomplete).

checks.accounting: inventory 3,147 = ledger 3,147; steps.jsonl lines = ledger; step ids unique; one disposition each; local 16: 83,206 resets and 78,604 steps reproduce exactly; six new: 30,455 resets, 28,763 steps
checks.identity_36: 30 levelground recordings: 227 eligible = 227 old exported+opposite, 479 outside = 479 old outside, 0 disagreements step by step. Treadmill 6 recordings: 1,564 steps held (speed table not exported), 1,427 of them the old run exported; so 856+798=1654 and 616 hold only after adding the speed table
checks.terrain: 11,947 eligible ramp/stair steps: label, incline sign, stair height equal source scalars and window; 0 mismatches; all 2,310 ramp/stair recordings (1,394 + 916) have a positive source value; none defaulted
checks.mask: layers for all 3,146 converted recordings equal an independent recomputation; 0 masked stance samples at or above 20 N; 0 unmasked stance samples below 20 N; scalar loop on 66 seeded recordings: 0 mismatches
checks.authors: right-leg intervals: 106,818 matched (start/end offset max 5 ms = one sample, median 0), extra 3,390 (partial first/last intervals, none interior), missed 0
checks.peak_memory: batches 160 MiB RSS (launcher largest process 160 MiB), readback 179 MiB under a 600 MiB cap

open_scope_question: Stair (and ramp) steps that touch two label windows are listed as straddling, not labelled: 12,360 of 17,093 stair steps (72%), ramp 19,094 of 32,913 (58%) straddle. 119 of 916 stair recordings have no eligible step. The authors' own STRIDES.m keeps most of these by first/last-label rules. Needs a scope decision before RB05.
treadmill: All 157 treadmill recordings / 41,157 steps are 'held': the RB01 label export did not capture the treadmill speed table, so steady speed cannot be assessed. Needs a small MATLAB speed export (22 starts) or a decision.
remaining: Scope decision on straddling stair/ramp steps
next_action: Independent verifier reviews acceptance against docs/quality/audits/gt21-rb03-readback.json and the ledgers.
